title: CRIC Repository Dependency and Implementation Sequence
summary: Converts the CRIC PRD family into a phased build order across repositories, with per-phase exit criteria, the coding-agent work package rule, and eight architecture freeze points.
notes: Ambiguity resolved SPEC over PRD/DOC. Path signal is weak PRD (parent dir 'CRIC-PRD-v0.1'), but content has no user stories, no goals/non-goals, no success metrics. Dominant content signals are implementation contracts: an ordered build sequence, a normative YAML schema ('work_package' with required fields), per-phase exit criteria, and an enumerated set of eight Architecture Freeze Points that later phases must honour. No YAML frontmatter, no status field, no Decision/Consequences sections, so not ADR. No markdown links or doc-path mentions in the source; repositories are named but no other documents are referenced, hence cross_refs is empty. Confidence medium because classification rests on content signals alone and the doc is partly a sequencing/roadmap plan, which the taxonomy has no dedicated type for.
